name: gnomon-injection
description: The Gnomon H1: the injection battery's world-building arm. Twenty census seeds (0-19), default pins, every registered metric — so a row produced here is column-for-column comparable with the-census's, which is the percentile prior the anomaly report scores it against. Run ONLY through scripts/gnomon-injection.sh, which perturbs one generative constant per arm and commits the resulting rows.csv as fixture evidence; a bare `lab run` of this study reproduces the unperturbed baseline arm and nothing else. Not a census (spec §3.5, decision 0016).
